whoami_title: I am a passionate full-stack developer based in Spain with over 8 years of experience.
whoami_headline: I embrace complex challenges and stay up to date with new technologies.
whoami_entry_1: As a full-stack developer with 8+ years of experience across various fields, including research during my time at university, I have developed a diverse skill set spanning both front-end and back-end development, as well as QA automation. In my previous roles, I have taken on complex challenges and developed scalable solutions that meet both business and user needs.
whoami_entry_2: Working as a QA automation engineer has given me a keen eye for detail and a strong understanding of the importance of testing and quality assurance in the software development process. With a passion for staying up-to-date with the latest technologies and trends, I enjoy exploring new tools and techniques to continually improve my work.
experience_celtiberian_description: Full-stack software development for international clients, ranging from web applications to low-level and highly concurrent systems. Specialized in the TypeScript ecosystem (Node.js, Express, NestJS, Next.js, React, and Angular) and Go. Experienced in technical leadership, particularly in backend development and software architecture, with a focus on designing and evolving scalable, high-performance systems.
experience_celtiberian_cipherscale_role: Full Stack Engineer / Back-end Lead / Architect
experience_celtiberian_cipherscale_descr:
Designed and developed a ZTNA (Zero Trust Network Access) VPN platform from the ground up, based on WireGuard and OpenVPN. Responsible for the architecture and low-level development of a highly concurrent system, including the design and implementation of a custom firewall and network services in Go. Also designed and integrated an LLM-powered chatbot using LangChain.

Tech stack: Go, TypeScript, NestJS, Next.js, WireGuard, OpenVPN, LangChain.
